baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled خ ل ف construction, framed by مِن بَعْدِهِمْ, makes succession itself the subject before naming lost prayer.
baseline_models.mechanism: A group takes the predecessors' place, but the relay changes and degrades at the point where its defining worship should be transmitted.

activation_trace.role: Coming after and standing in another's place supplies the succession relay.
A deficient successor supplies the relay's evaluative failure.
Temporal after-ness fixes the failure within intergenerational sequence.
Loss and letting-go identify what happened to the transmitted practice.
Specific worship is the practice at which continuity breaks.

changed_reading.after: Occupants of an inherited place broke a worship-bearing relay; the ayah diagnoses failed succession, not mere lateness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَضَاعُوا الصلاةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَاتِ places abandoned prayer beside an explicit new object of following.
baseline_models.mechanism: Successors who should continue a received path transfer followership to inward pulls; craving-after-craving becomes an alternative procession.

activation_trace.role: Succession supplies the path that should have been continued.
Following and going behind assign desires the functional place of a guide.
Uninterrupted sequence turns the choice into a continuing behavioral chain.
The soul's pull toward an object supplies the rival directional force.
Desire renewed after desire supplies the rival chain's iterative motion.

changed_reading.before: They missed prayer and also indulged desires.
changed_reading.after: The two clauses describe a transfer of guidance: inherited worship loses command while serial appetite becomes the leader they trail.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object of أَضَاعُوا is الصلاة, a recurrent practice rather than a single possession.
baseline_models.mechanism: Prayer behaves like an entrusted holding that disappears when upkeep stops; proliferating concerns and cravings scatter attention until no duty is tended first.

activation_trace.role: An estate that wastes without tending supplies the maintenance analogy.
Proliferating concerns that prevent choosing where to begin supply attentional overload.
The specific recurring worship is the holding that requires upkeep.
One desire after another supplies the multiplying claims on attention.

changed_reading.after: The ayah can also expose cumulative non-maintenance: recurring worship is allowed to dissipate amid multiplying claims.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا converts the act of following into a later encounter.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following desires carries a trailing liability; the follower eventually meets the dark failure and corrupted life generated along that route.

activation_trace.role: A liability that adheres and follows supplies the consequence trailing the pursuit.
What one encounters of good or evil makes consequence a confronting event.
Deviation opposed to right guidance gives the encounter its directional failure.
Failure and corrupted living make the encountered result more than an abstract wrong idea.

changed_reading.before: An unrelated punishment follows their conduct.
changed_reading.after: Their chosen following acquires its own follower: a liability that matures into the failure they must face.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate exception joins intentional repair to a later selective inheritance, recasting failed succession as a reversible mode of transmission rather than a hereditary identity.

activation_trace.role: The deficient successor supplies the condition being revised.
Intentional action makes reversal operative rather than merely inward.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the direction of changed practice.
Transfer from predecessor to heir reopens succession under a different criterion.
Placing oneself in protection supplies the heir's qualifying posture.

structural_cues: 19:60 opens with an exception to 19:59 and sequences repentance, trust, and repaired action.
19:63 restricts inheritance to a protected or mindful servant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exception, purposeful repair, predecessor-to-heir transfer, and self-protection; I infer that the broken relay can be requalified and resumed. A live alternative is that heavenly inheritance concerns outcome only, not repair of the earthly succession.

changed_reading.before: The successors form a fixed condemned generation.
changed_reading.after: Bad succession is a repairable transmission-state: corrected action can turn a failed successor into a qualified heir.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired edges of the day and recurrent apportioned provision sharpen prayer-loss as collapse of a maintained cadence, not a pile of isolated omissions.

activation_trace.role: An unattended holding supplies the baseline model of neglected upkeep.
Specific worship anchors the inferred daily practice.
Apportioned giving supplies a recurrent reception rather than self-directed acquisition.
The beginning of daylight supplies one boundary of the cadence.
Evening time supplies the cadence's answering boundary.

structural_cues: 19:62 pairs بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا around recurring provision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies specific worship, unattended-property imagery, apportioned provision, and two daily endpoints; I infer a rhythm whose repeated tending resists dissipation. The live alternative is that the time pair describes paradise provision without activating prayer cadence.

changed_reading.before: They failed a set of separate ritual acts.
changed_reading.after: They let the recurring temporal scaffold that ordered attention and reception fall out of maintenance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Command, the denial of divine neglect, and an imperative of persistent worship distinguish active human dissipation from faithful sustained upkeep.

activation_trace.role: Letting the practice go supplies the human failure under comparison.
Demand and obligation identify the governing source displaced by desire.
Leaving and neglecting, explicitly denied of the Lord, supplies the contrast to human waste.
Submissive worship restates the positive practice under divine command.
Bearing an obligation with persistence supplies the maintenance mode.

structural_cues: 19:64 restricts descent to command and closes by denying that the Lord neglects.
19:65 couples the worship imperative with an intensified persistence imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies binding command, non-neglect, worship, and persistent obligation; I infer that wasting prayer is failed sustained attention to its rightful authority. The live alternative is that the denial of forgetting concerns angelic descent only and should not characterize 19:59 directly.

changed_reading.after: A commanded practice was actively left untended when persistent worship should have kept it under its proper authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passage repeatedly makes futures converge on their subjects: a promise comes, all arrive at a fixed threshold, and a warning is eventually seen. Meeting ghayy therefore reads as an approaching counter-promise, not only a later sentence.

activation_trace.role: Two opposed things coming together supplies the reciprocal encounter.
Failure and corrupted living identify the adverse future met.
A promise that opens hope supplies the positive counterpart to the adverse encounter.
Coming and arrival make the promised future itself approach.
Arrival at a thing supplies the later threshold structure.
Threat-promise supplies the explicitly adverse appointment eventually made visible.

structural_cues: 19:59 has prospective سوف plus encounter; 19:61 calls the merciful promise coming; 19:75 delays only until the promised warning is seen.
19:71 places universal arrival under a fixed decree, while 19:72 still differentiates rescue from being left there.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies encounter, a promise that comes, threshold-arrival, and an eventual threat-promise; I infer a passage-wide appointment structure in which futures move toward people as people move toward them. A live alternative is that the later arrivals have distinct referents and only echo, rather than specify, ghayy.

changed_reading.before: They will later receive a punishment called ghayy.
changed_reading.after: Their chosen route and its adverse future converge at an appointment; ghayy approaches as the warning-side counterpart to a promise that also comes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Boasted assembly, abundant goods, and superior appearance give الشهوات a social-material register: prestige can become the guide that displaces prayer while masking a generation's failure.

activation_trace.role: Following assigns the desired prestige objects a guiding role.
The soul's pull toward what it wants admits status and display, not only bodily appetite.
The gathered social club supplies prestige through visible company.
Abundant goods supply the material metric used to boast superiority.
Visible appearance supplies the display surface that can conceal relay failure.

structural_cues: 19:73 makes station and assembly comparative boasts; 19:74 answers with destroyed generations that had better goods and appearance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies desire as inward pull and later boasts in assembly, goods, and appearance; I infer that prestige appetite is one concrete rival authority behind prayer-loss. The live alternative is that the boasts characterize only the later disputants and do not define 19:59's desires.

changed_reading.before: The desires are primarily private or sensual urges.
changed_reading.after: They can include a public prestige economy in which company, possessions, and appearance direct the successors more strongly than inherited worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing pair sets extension in error against increase in guidance and enduring repaired acts, turning 19:59's followership into one of two paths that compound through time.

activation_trace.role: Continuous following supplies the path's repeated motion.
Desire after desire supplies iterative input to the adverse path.
Departure from guidance names the adverse trajectory explicitly.
An extended duration supplies room for the adverse trajectory to continue.
Increase and growth supply the positive trajectory's compounding motion.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies the rival guidance.
Persistence and remaining supply the durable output opposite prayer's dissipation.

structural_cues: 19:75 and 19:76 form adjacent trajectories: error is extended, while the guided are increased in guidance and their repaired acts remain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies serial appetite, extended error, increased guidance, and enduring acts; I infer feedback paths in which repeated following compounds direction over time. The live alternative is that extension and increase are solely external divine responses rather than dynamics already implicit in each path.

changed_reading.before: Prayer-loss and desire-following are static traits of one group.
changed_reading.after: They initiate an accumulating route: repeated appetite lengthens deviation, while sustained guidance produces acts that remain instead of dissipating.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the shared mapped inventory pivots from obligatory prayer at 19:59 to fire-contact at 19:70. It remains anchored in الصلاة, the later صِلِيًّا, and the focus encounter construction, but downstream prose must present it only as a passage-internal branch activation, not as an etymological equation or a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The lost الصلاة and the later صِلِيًّا resolve to opposed branches of the same mapped ص ل ي inventory.

activation_trace.role: Obligatory worship supplies the relation the successors discard.
Encountering what befalls a person supplies the hinge toward the later exposure.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies the opposed branch activated later in the sequence.

changed_reading.before: Prayer-loss and later fire exposure are lexically unrelated stages.
changed_reading.after: The packet permits a contained branch-turn: abandoning one ص ل ي relation is followed by confronting its fire-contact branch.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates غَيّ as hunger or emptiness rather than its dominant moral-direction sense. It remains anchored by followed appetites and is sharpened by apportioned nourishment in 19:62, but downstream prose should retain it as a material reversal image, not substitute 'hunger' as the sole lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الشهوات names appetitive pull, while the focus inventory gives غَيّ a branch of perishing from hunger or emptiness.

activation_trace.role: The soul's pull toward a desired object supplies appetite seeking satisfaction.
Perishing from hunger or emptiness reverses the appetite's expected result.
Nourishing sustenance supplies the controlled alternative to appetite-driven pursuit.

changed_reading.before: Following appetite promises satisfaction but earns an abstract error.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory material layer, uncontrolled appetite culminates in the emptiness it sought to escape, opposed to received nourishment.

strongest_changes: The focus ayah is a failed transmission mechanism: successors occupy an inherited place but transfer followership from worship to serial appetite.
The exception and inheritance cues make that failure repairable and selective rather than hereditary.
Commanded persistence and daily cadence sharpen 'wasting prayer' as sustained non-maintenance.
The closing extension/increase pair turns the focus into two compounding directional paths.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation was the collision of succession, following, and maintenance: the successors fail precisely by following the wrong guide, while later inheritance, persistence, arrival, and increase expose both repair and trajectory. The contained prayer/fire and appetite/hunger branch-turns preserve packet-supported surprises without making them primary translations.
remaining_uncertainties: The morning/evening provision pair may orient paradise rhythm without specifically activating prayer cadence.
Later promise and arrival constructions may echo the focus encounter without sharing its exact referent.
The prestige reading concretizes desires plausibly but is not grammatically forced.
The prayer/fire and appetite/hunger outliers depend on deliberately distant inventory branches and must remain qualified.
